quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Nokia launches flexible 50G/25G/10GPON solution to (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fixed Networks product launch: Nokia announced a new 16-port 50G/25G/10G/GPON line card that supports GPON, 10G, 25G and 50G PON on every port (company claim: the first vendor with such a 16-port line card), built on Nokia's in-house Quillion chipset and multi-PON optical modules, enabling fiber access speeds up to 50Gbps; operators can add or change PON generations on the same port and fiber. Stated features: up to 4x lower upstream latency and quantum-safe encryption and authentication. General availability is planned for 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 16-port; up to 50Gbps; up to 4x lower upstream latency; general availability planned for 2027
